title: Workflow
html:
For creating automated workflows (for example from the quotation to issuing the invoice). In the project, the record follows the workflow through; the status of the event always stands at the current value, then switches to the next one after closing.

When creating a new workflow, give it a name (an active workflow can be selected for a project; an inactive one cannot). The expiry of the workflow means that if nothing changes either before or after the deadline, a warning message is sent to the owner with this delay.
